name: Omega
description: The omega.x series (omega.3, omega.6, and omega.7) by Force Dimension is a family of desktop parallel-kinematic haptic interfaces based on a delta mechanical structure for low-inertia, high-stiffness 3-DOF translational force feedback. The omega.3 provides 3 active translational degrees of freedom; the omega.6 adds a 3-DOF passive gimbal wrist for 6-DOF position and orientation sensing; and the omega.7 replaces the passive wrist handle with a 1-DOF active motorized force-feedback pinch gripper (7 DOFs total, 4 actuated). Equipped with active gravity compensation and a high-frequency C/C++ and ROS SDK, omega devices are widely integrated as OEM master controllers in surgical robotics platforms such as the [Raven-II](/robot/raven_II) and [EndoMaster EASE](/robot/endomaster_ease).
